name: Archives
description: Zip archives: list what is inside, extract entries, and build archives from named content.

operations.name: zip.list
operations.description: Lists a zip archive's entries. Returns {entries: [{name, size, compressed}], count}.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A picked zip (file.pick's file output); preferred over base64

inputs.name: base64
inputs.description: Legacy alternative to "file": base64 from file.read

outputs.name: entries
outputs.description: Entry objects with name, size, compressed

operations.howto: Chain after file.pick + file.read; route "entries" into state and bind a list element's items to it (rows read item fields name and size). Feed "file" straight from file.pick; base64 via file.read is the legacy path.

operations.name: zip.extract
operations.description: Extracts one entry. Inputs base64 + name; returns {base64, text, name, size} (text null for binary entries).

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A picked zip (file.pick's file output); preferred over base64

inputs.name: base64
inputs.description: Legacy alternative to "file": base64 from file.read

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Entry name from zip.list (item field "name" works)

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The extracted entry as a file, when the archive came from a pick; chains into file.save

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: UTF-8 content for text entries; null for binary

operations.howto: A per-row Extract button passes the row's name via {"source": "item", "sourceId": "name"}; chain file.save with the extracted base64 to land it on disk. From a picked archive, route the "file" output to file.save; the text output stays for showing readable entries.

operations.name: zip.create
operations.description: Builds a zip from entries [{name, base64 or text}]. Returns {base64, size, count}; feed base64 to file.save.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Unused; name the file at file.save

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The zip as a produced file; chains into file.save

operations.howto: Bind "entries" from a state array your app builds (list.append rows with name and text fields work as-is); chain file.save with a .zip name. Prefer routing the "file" output to file.save's file input.
